mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.purchase_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, IFNULL(SUM(d.quantity * d.cost_price), 0) AS amount FROM purchase_order o JOIN purchase_order_detail d ON d.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = '已入库' AND o.purchase_date >= #{fromMonth} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.purchase_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.sale_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, IFNULL(SUM(d.quantity * d.sale_price), 0) AS amount FROM sale_order o JOIN sale_order_detail d ON d.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = '已出库' AND o.sale_date >= #{fromMonth} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.sale_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month
SELECT IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(category), ''), '未分类') AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM product GROUP BY IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(category), ''), '未分类') ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT l.change_time AS changeTime, l.change_type AS changeType, l.change_quantity AS changeQuantity, l.related_order_no AS relatedOrderNo, l.remark AS remark, IFNULL(p.name, '') AS productName FROM inventory_log l LEFT JOIN product p ON p.id = l.product_id ORDER BY l.change_time DESC, l.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT IFNULL(p.name, '') AS productName, IFNULL(SUM(d.shipped_quantity), 0) AS quantity FROM sale_order_detail d JOIN sale_order o ON o.id = d.order_id LEFT JOIN product p ON p.id = d.product_id WHERE o.status = '已出库' AND DATE_FORMAT(o.sale_date, '%Y-%m') = #{month} GROUP BY d.product_id, p.name ORDER BY quantity DESC LIMIT #{limit}
